svg.title: Nearshore seabed off Aldbrough, Holderness, with a profile from cliff top to sea
svg.desc: Depth map of four by three kilometres of the Holderness nearshore from the Environment Agency SurfZone DEM 2019, in two-metre depth bands to 15 metres below datum, with a shore-normal profile from the cliff top out to sea.
svg.text: Nearshore seabed off Aldbrough, Holderness: one surface from cliff top to seabed
Seabed gradient, shoreline to 8 m deep
Profile C to D, from the cliff top out to sea (m, Ordnance Datum)
Drawn by Beck & Call Digital from the Environment Agency SurfZone DEM 2019, a published surface joining land LIDAR to seabed data. Not for navigation.
